Connected Cars is on an ambitious mission to connect millions of vehicles through real-time data, enabling safer and more sustainable mobility. Our team of ~70 people is driven by a shared belief in community, team effort, and quality solutions.

The Position

As we rapidly scale across international markets, we are looking for a Head of Support & Training. Exceptional support and structured customer training are core drivers of our product adoption. Sitting within the Commercial team, you will lead a dedicated technical product support team of 5, act as a proactive operational bridge for our Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to help them translate technical solutions into tangible customer value, and drive the onboarding strategy for 15–20 international Customer Interaction Centre (CIC) stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Team Empowerment & Leadership: Mentor and develop a team of 5 Product Support Specialists (including one fully remote). After our in depth onboarding, you will step back from daily ticket execution to empower the team, delegating ownership of strategic projects and functional areas so they can grow as independent, proactive professionals.

• Proactive Commercial Enablement: Partner closely with Sales & CS, moving beyond reactive troubleshooting to actively equip CSMs with the technical insights and operational backing needed to unlock customer value and drive account expansion.

• Technical Escalations: Serve as the senior escalation point for complex enterprise issues across our hardware, telematics, and app ecosystem, ensuring prompt root-cause resolution.

• Enterprise Partner Governance: Lead the onboarding and training of 15 -20 international CIC and market support leads, ensuring local operations can support our product at scale.

• Zendesk Architecture: Own and optimize our Zendesk setup - designing efficient ticket routing, automation, SLAs, and performance metrics.

• Training Frameworks: Collaborate with Product & Brand Marketing to create scalable training templates and academy materials for internal teams, external CICs, and end-users.

What You Bring

• Support Leadership: A proven track record of leading B2B technical support in a high-growth SaaS, IoT, or tech environment, with a strong focus on fostering team autonomy and delegating project leadership.

• Technical & Commercial Acumen: Comfortable with software integrations, app/hardware diagnostics, and APIs, paired with a strong understanding of how proactive support drives product adoption, customer value, and long-term retention.

• Global Stakeholder Management: Experience working with multinational enterprise accounts and multi-market partner teams.

• Zendesk Expertise: Hands-on experience configuring and administering Zendesk for automated, scalable workflows.

• Communication: Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to translate complex technical realities into clear guidance for both technical and commercial stakeholders.

Why Connected Cars?

• The opportunity to shape a vital support function during a critical phase of international growth.

• A collaborative culture valuing technical rigor and commercial ambition.

• Competitive salary, attractive pension, Friday bars, monthly social events, affordable lunch scheme, and unlimited office snacks.

Connected Cars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

How to Apply

Please apply via LinkedIn with an up-to-date CV. A cover letter is optional, but feel free to add one if there is extra context you’d like to share.

Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

Our IoT team builds the devices and edge software that connect our customers' production lines to the Factbird platform, from sensors on the line to industrial edge computers running computer vision right next to the machines. We're a small team with broad ownership, and we're hiring an Embedded Platform Engineer to help build and run the platform our edge products stand on.

About the Role

As Embedded Platform Engineer, you'll work hands-on across Factbird EDGE, our industrial edge platform, together with the rest of the IoT team: the operating system, the device software, and the vision models that run on it. You'll take ownership of the infrastructure around the devices: provisioning and recovery, over-the-air updates, and fleet observability, the systems that keep our unattended devices reliable, secure, and safely updatable in factories you may never visit.

You'll work in Rust on embedded Linux, with Yocto, AWS IoT Greengrass, GStreamer and ONNX Runtime at the core, alongside our Cloud and DevOps engineers and the people building our AI capabilities. Part of the job is shaping the role with the team as our edge products grow.

You'll thrive here if you like working across a system end to end, from the bootloader to the cloud connection, and if you'd rather fix the root cause in the build than patch around it on the device.

What you'll do

Embedded Linux & the EDGE platform

• Develop our Yocto-based Linux distribution: layers, BSPs, kernel configuration, and reproducible builds

• Build and maintain the Rust components that run on our edge devices

• Bring up new hardware platforms, debug on target, and keep the platform secure and maintainable over a long device lifetime

• Keep our CI and on-hardware testing healthy, so changes reach devices with confidence

Edge inference & vision

• Work with our ML and vision engineers on the device side of our computer vision capabilities: camera pipelines, video streaming, and model inference that runs efficiently on industrial hardware

• Share ownership with our ML engineers of how trained models move from our model pipeline onto devices and how they perform there: packaging, rollout, rollback, and drift monitoring

• Help bring new edge runtimes for vision workloads from development into production

Fleet infrastructure & ownership

• Own device provisioning, over-the-air updates, and fleet observability

• Make deployments to devices in the field safe and boring: staged rollouts, health checks, and recovery paths

• Help diagnose issues on devices at customer sites, working with Support, Product, and Cloud to turn them into lasting fixes

• Share knowledge in both directions: learn the parts of the platform others built, and make sure what you build doesn't live only in your head

What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineer who has shipped embedded Linux into production and lived with it afterwards: someone who has debugged a device they couldn't touch, and who wants real responsibility rather than a ticket queue.

You work independently, but you don't work alone. You can take a loosely defined problem and move it forward without daily direction, and you pull others in early, because on a small team the best fix is one more than one person understands. You're disciplined where it matters, in releases and rollouts, and curious where it pays off, in vision and new hardware.

You don't need everything below. Yocto is the core. Rust matters, but strong C/C++ engineers who have started with Rust are welcome too. The rest you can grow into with us.

The ideal background

• Hands-on experience shipping embedded Linux to production, including Yocto: layers, BSPs and images you've built and maintained yourself, not just consumed

• Strong systems programming in Rust, or deep C/C++ experience on embedded Linux and real exposure to Rust that you want to build on

• An advantage if you have worked with AWS IoT Core or Greengrass, video pipelines or ML inference on edge hardware, or in industrial settings where devices run unattended for years

• A solid grasp of embedded security and update mechanisms: signed images, A/B or similar update schemes, and secure device provisioning

• You can explain a technical trade-off clearly, whether you're talking to another engineer, Support or a customer, and you do it in fluent English

• We welcome applications from people eager to move to Denmark, as long as you already have the legal right to live and work here.

Why Factbird?

People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We'll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we'll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what's next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

We'd love to hear from you

If this role feels like a match, we'd be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Cristina Vartej at crva@factbird.com

_Intro

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is not a nice-to-have at Monta. It's how we work. Engineers use Claude Code daily. We ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean because of it. We expect everyone to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI, not just use it passively.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people: sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role where you'll own the architecture and delivery of complex financial systems, working across teams to ensure we can scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes full ownership of what they build. Not someone who waits for direction, but someone who sees what needs to happen, drives it forward, and delivers. You will own projects end-to-end, from technical design through to production, and you'll be accountable for outcomes, not just output.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• Redesign Monta's financial backbone. You'll architect and build the new invoicing system that every customer will use, replacing the current infrastructure with a foundation built for serious scale.

• Unblock EU expansion. You'll build the compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

What You Will Do

• Own the new invoice system end-to-end. Design and deliver a new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows as the business scales into new markets.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Drive architecture decisions for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll design for auditability, correctness, and scale.

• Elevate the team around you. Contribute to the growth of the Financial Services engineering team through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

What We're Looking For

• Strong backend engineering experience. You've built and maintained production systems at scale. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Experience with financial systems. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness and reliability are non-negotiable.

• Proven ability to own architecture across teams. You don't just write code, you shape systems. You've led technical design for complex projects that span multiple teams.

• A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. When something needs to happen, you make it happen. You don't wait to be asked.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity. Regulatory landscapes shift, business models evolve, and priorities change. You bring structure where there is none.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus

**

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

**AI at Monta Engineering

• AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

• Tools we use daily:

• Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode. Your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one. We don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The people are extraordinary. Talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

What We Offer

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

A property manager can handle 600 tenants. That's the industry limit. Why? Because the work scales linearly: matching bank transactions to invoices, chasing late payments, answering tenant questions, coordinating repairs, preparing legal notices, renewing leases. More tenants, more of the same manual work.

With AI, that limit disappears. And both landlords and tenants get a better experience.

**About Rumli

**Eight years in property operations. ~1,000 customers across Denmark, the Netherlands, and Germany. We know this industry: the workflows, the pain points, the regulations.

Now we're making a big move: becoming a property manager. Tenant communication, bookkeeping, coordinating repairs. We handle it all. A landlord shouldn't chase late payments or find a plumber at 10 pm. We do it for them.

We're building an entirely new platform to power this. AI-native from day one. Profitable, real customers, expanding across the Nordics.

**Why this is interesting

**Property management is a great domain for a product engineer. Thousands of similar transactions, pattern-based decisions, templated documents. And 1,000 customers who will tell you exactly where it hurts. Years of domain knowledge, ready to turn into a product.

We ship with AI agents built into the workflow. Our codebase has custom skills to improve our workflow. AI writes a lot of the code; we review it. That means the slow part of building isn't writing code anymore. It's knowing what to build. That's what this role is about.

**The role

**You are autonomous and independent, working with the team to solve property managers' pains and make them as efficient as possible.

• Talk to customers and property managers. Find out what actually slows them down

• Decide what to build, then build it. Mockup, prototype, ship, measure, repeat

• Own features end-to-end. Database to API to UI

• Build AI into core product features

• Work directly with our co-founder on product direction

We need someone who looks at a messy problem and figures out what to build, and doesn't wait for a spec.

**Tech stack

**TypeScript everywhere. But does it even matter anymore?

• Frontend: Next.js, React, Shadcn, Tailwind CSS

• Backend: NestJS, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM

• Infra: AWS Lambda, CDK, RDS, EventBridge, SQS

**What We're Looking For

**

• Product thinking. You understand what it takes to build a profitable product. You are not here just to handle tickets.

• Strong product mindset. Agents can code, but they need scoping and steering.

• You've shipped things people actually use, and you can show them.

• Comfortable talking to customers.

• Experience with coding agents.

• Work independently.

• Copenhagen-based (on-site).

Big plus: AWS, AI experience (prompt engineering, RAG, agents), fintech/proptech background, a side project you're proud of.

**Compensation & Benefits

**

• Compensation: 50–65K DKK, depending on experience and demonstrated competencies

• Equity: Employee warrants offering real ownership in the company

• Workspace: Centrally located Copenhagen office

• Perks: Daily lunch included

**Why Rumli?

**Real customers. Brand-new codebase. Small team where your decisions matter.

We're rebuilding from the ground up with AI as the foundation. If you want to decide what property software should do, not just build what someone else specified, reach out.

**30+ million tons of commodity flows. An international network of clients. And a freight intelligence platform built to see opportunities in the market.

**At Copenhagen Merchants Group, we are looking for a Freight Broker who can bring these strengths together and turn commercial opportunities into business.

This is a role for someone who enjoys building relationships, developing new business and finding opportunities where others might not immediately see them. Someone who combines the instincts of a broker with the curiosity to explore how data and technology can make a good broker even better.

**Why this role exists

**Every year, Copenhagen Merchants Group is involved in more than 30 million tonnes of commodity business across our brokerage and terminal activities.

Behind these volumes is an extensive network of commodity traders, cargo owners, shipping professionals and market relationships. Combined with the freight intelligence capabilities of CM Navigator, this provides a strong foundation for developing our freight brokerage activities.

We want to build on that foundation.

Working alongside our commodity brokers, CM Navigator and our colleagues across the Group, you will help identify freight opportunities, develop new client relationships and expand our presence within grains and other dry bulk commodities.

The ambition is straightforward: to build a successful freight brokerage business by combining sound commercial judgement, strong relationships and better use of the information already available to us.

**The role

**You will have considerable room to shape your own business, while benefiting from the relationships, market knowledge and capabilities of an established international group.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing freight business in close collaboration with our commodity brokers, identifying opportunities arising from existing trading relationships and commodity flows.

• Turning enquiries into fixtures, including freight requests from CM Navigator's international client base.

• Building your own portfolio of cargo owners and operators, developing new business within grains and other dry bulk commodities.

• Making intelligent use of data, drawing on CM Navigator's freight intelligence, market information and digital tools to support your commercial decisions.

• Contributing market insight to CM Navigator's freight research team, helping ensure that its freight rates and market intelligence remain commercially relevant.

• Working across the Group, building strong relationships with colleagues in commodity brokerage, Navi Merchants and other CM businesses to identify opportunities and make the most of our combined capabilities.

We believe that good brokerage is built on relationships, judgement, persistence and timing. Technology will not replace those qualities. But used well, it can make them considerably more powerful.

**Who We Are Looking For

**You already know the dry bulk freight market and have demonstrated that you can develop business rather than simply manage what comes your way.

Ideally, you bring 2–7 years of experience in freight brokerage, along with a solid understanding of the commercial dynamics between cargo owners, operators and the wider shipping market.

Beyond that, we are looking for someone who:

• Has a natural commercial drive and enjoys the challenge of winning new business.

• Takes ownership, follows through and knows that relationships are built over time.

• Is curious, resourceful and quick to recognise commercial opportunities.

• Is comfortable working with technology and interested in how data and AI can support better commercial decisions.

• Builds trust easily, both with clients and colleagues.

• Keeps a clear head when markets move quickly and circumstances change.

• Communicates confidently and fluently in English.

We are less concerned about your educational background than your experience, judgement and appetite for building business.

**What You Can Expect

**You will become part of Copenhagen Merchants Group, an international, family-owned business with activities across commodity brokerage, shipping, logistics, terminals and technology.

You will have the opportunity to develop freight brokerage activities with the backing of an established commercial network, access to substantial commodity flows and the analytical capabilities of CM Navigator.

At the same time, we expect you to bring your own initiative, relationships and ideas to the table.

This is not a role where business simply arrives at your desk. But neither is it one where you have to build everything from scratch.

You will be based in Copenhagen, with approximately 20–30 travel days annually to visit clients, meet colleagues and participate in relevant industry events.

**Interested?

**Upload your CV and a short video introduction (max. 60 seconds). Tell us what makes you curious about Copenhagen Merchants Group, what drives you as a broker, and why you believe there might be a little Merchanteer in you.

We look forward to getting to know you.

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

Getting a promising treatment into a clinical trial takes more than good science. Patients need medicines and delivery devices they can rely on, made to the right standards and available when needed.

As Associate Director, QA Drug Product & Device, you'll own quality oversight of our drug product manufacturing partners and combination product development. You'll work closely with CMC, Manufacturing and device development colleagues to resolve quality risks, keep clinical supplies moving and build the quality framework Hemab needs as its pipeline advances.

What you'll do

• Ensure QA oversight of selected drug product CDMOs and fill-finish activities in collaboration with the CMC and Manufacturing team

• Ensure QA oversight of design controls and risk management for combination products, including review and approval of design control deliverables, in line with 21 CFR Part 4 and EU MDR Article 117

• QA review and approval of master and executed batch records, specifications, protocols and reports

• Oversee and manage drug product deviations, CAPAs and change controls

• Ensure batch documentation is complete and release-ready, and support the Qualified Person in the certification and release of drug product and combination product batches

• Create and review quality agreements with drug product CDMOs and suppliers

• Advise and support the CMC and Manufacturing team as quality lead for selected programs

• Participate in building and improving fit-for-purpose quality systems and processes as Hemab grows, and contribute to projects across Quality and the wider organization

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Hands-on QA experience with combination products or drug-device products, including design controls and ISO 14971 risk management

• Experience overseeing drug product CDMOs, ideally aseptic fill-finish, including audits and quality agreements

• Working knowledge of EU GMP (including Annex 1), 21 CFR Parts 210/211 and 600-610, and 21 CFR Part 4 and ISO 13485.

• A collaborative, cross-functional working style, partnering closely with CMC & Manufacturing, device development, supply chain and regulatory colleagues

• Good communication skills. English is our company language, so you are comfortable writing and speaking it professionally

• A solution-oriented and hands-on way of working, comfortable taking ownership and shaping processes as the organization evolves.

Nice to have Eligibility, or a realistic path, to act as an EU Qualified Person

• Experience with prefilled syringes, autoinjectors or other injectable delivery systems

• Danish language skills

What to expect, honestly

You'll be accountable for quality, but much of the manufacturing happens outside Hemab. That means working through CDMOs, sometimes with incomplete information, competing timelines and decisions that cannot wait. You'll need to know when to challenge, when to escalate and when there's enough evidence to move forward.

Drug product manufacturing and device development don't always move at the same pace. A late deviation, an unresolved design control issue or missing batch documentation can affect clinical supply. You'll need to get close to the detail, work directly with partners and find a compliant way forward.

Some of our quality frameworks are still being built. You'll help establish them while managing today's work. If you prefer established systems and clearly separated responsibilities, this may be frustrating. If you enjoy building sensible ways of working that protect patients without slowing good decisions, there's room to make a real difference.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hemab Therapeutics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. The role

We're adding a Clinical Trial Manager to take ownership of study delivery as our clinical portfolio grows. You'll be responsible for turning clinical development plans into well-run trials, keeping sites, CROs and internal teams focused on what matters: enrolling patients, protecting their safety and generating reliable data.

Based in Copenhagen, you'll work closely with Clinical Operations colleagues and teams across both locations. This is a hands-on role with room to shape how we run studies as Hemab grows.

What you'll do

• Take ownership of the day-to-day delivery of assigned clinical trials, from start-up through close-out, against agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards.

• Drive site activation and patient recruitment, working with investigators and CROs to identify obstacles early and find practical solutions.

• Manage CROs and external vendors, holding partners accountable for their commitments and addressing performance issues directly.

Nice to have

• Experience in rare diseases, haematology or coagulation.

• Experience working in a smaller biotech company or helping establish clinical trial ways of working.

• Experience with international, multicentre clinical studies.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

We are looking for a Senior Patent Attorney to play a central role in protecting and enabling innovation across Demant's global business and help shape the future of our Intellectual Property function.

In this role, you will partner closely with R&D teams, engineers, scientists, and business stakeholders to ensure that Demant continues to develop and launch innovative products with the lowest possible litigation risk. You will contribute to the growth and strengthening of our international patent portfolio while providing strategic IP guidance that supports our business ambitions.

This role requires more than technical expertise and patent law knowledge. It requires curiosity, commercial understanding, good stakeholder management, and the ability to translate complex technologies into valuable intellectual property. This is where you come in.

Welcome to Demant Intellectual Property

You will join Demant's Intellectual Property team at our Demant headquarters in Smørum, just outside Copenhagen, and become part of a highly skilled and collaborative team consisting of Patent Attorneys, Trademark Attorneys, and IP Paralegals.

Demant is a growing, world-leading hearing healthcare corporation that offers solutions in hearing devices, diagnostic instruments, and intelligent audio and video equipment. Through innovative technologies and deep expertise, we are dedicated to making life-changing differences for people with hearing loss around the world.

Our team consists of 14 colleagues from several different nationalities and professional backgrounds. We believe that results are achieved through collaboration and knowledge-sharing. We actively support one another, provide constructive feedback, and continuously develop our collective expertise in both technology and intellectual property.

Working closely with globally distributed business units and R&D organizations, our primary purpose is to help ensure that Demant's products can successfully reach the market while minimizing intellectual property risks.

Help protect the innovations of tomorrow

Joining us, you will bring an intellectual property perspective to strategic technology decisions and help researchers, engineers, and business leaders navigate an increasingly complex innovation landscape.

A key part of your role will be identifying opportunities and risks early in the development process and helping stakeholders answer critical questions: Are we free to commercialize this technology? How can we strengthen our competitive position? How can we protect our innovations globally? And how do we build an IP portfolio that supports Demant's long-term business strategy?

You will work across the boundaries of technology, law, and business, helping transform ideas into protected innovations while supporting product and technology development from concept to market launch.

In this role, you will

• Support innovation throughout the product lifecycle – Participate in R&D project groups and provide IP guidance throughout the development process and help teams make informed technology and business decisions.

• Drive freedom-to-operate activities – Conduct analyses and provide strategic advice to ensure products can be launched with the lowest possible litigation risk.

• Expand and strengthen Demant's patent portfolio – Evaluate invention disclosures, identify patentable innovations, and actively contribute to the growth of our international patent portfolio.

• Manage patent drafting and prosecution – Prepare, file, and prosecute patent applications in multiple jurisdictions while working closely with inventors and external partners.

• Analyze competitor patents – Prepare, file, and present at opposition proceedings before the European Patent Office

• Develop intellectual property expertise – Contribute to the team's collective knowledge within technology and patent law while continuously expanding your own professional capabilities.

By joining Demant, you will step into a highly visible role where your ability to connect technology, intellectual property, and business strategy will directly support innovation and help protect products that improve the lives of people across the world.

What You Bring

You have a scientific or technical background combined with practical intellectual property experience and a genuine interest in understanding how innovation creates business value.

You bring:

• Qualification as a European Patent Attorney or as a US Patent Attorney.

• 5+ years of experience within intellectual property, gained either in industry, private practice, or a combination of both.

• A scientific or technical degree, preferably within physics, electronics, or a related field.

• Excellent analytical capabilities and the ability to quickly understand new technologies and technical concepts.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex IP matters clearly to a broad range of stakeholders.

• A structured and systematic approach combined with strong attention to detail.

• An interest in understanding business needs and translating them into effective IP strategies.

Finally, you are curious, collaborative, and enjoy working closely with experts across different disciplines. You combine technical depth with commercial awareness, build trusted relationships with stakeholders, and are motivated by helping innovation succeed.

Flexible Working Conditions

At Demant, we work in a collaborative environment built on trust, openness, and strong professional relationships. Networking and knowledge-sharing are essential parts of how we work.

We offer you flexible working conditions, excellent opportunities for professional development, and a highly skilled team that works towards a common goal. From the moment you enter our premises, you will experience Demant's energizing and welcoming spirit.

Join our diverse organization and work alongside colleagues from many different nationalities and backgrounds while contributing to technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives.

Come and join us

Please note that we only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system.

Do you thrive at the intersection of technology and governance? Are you equally comfortable discussing access models with data engineers and governance frameworks with business stakeholders?

At Tryg, we're looking for a Data Platform Governance Architect who can bridge the gap between governance ambitions and technical reality, helping us build a scalable, secure, and trusted data platform that enables better decisions across the business.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have helped design, establish, or mature enterprise-scale data platforms and who understand what a well-functioning platform looks like from both a governance and architecture perspective.

About the role | Bridging governance, platform architecture and technology

As our new Data Platform Governance Architect, you will act as the technical bridge between our data governance and data platform teams. Your primary responsibility is to translate governance requirements into clear, actionable technical specifications while ensuring governance stakeholders understand platform capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs.

You will draw on your hands-on experience from data platform architecture, data platform engineering, data management, or governance roles to define robust, implementable governance requirements. You will also help design and implement governance processes and feedback loops. You will work closely with the platform team, which is responsible for implementing the technical solutions.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Defining governance requirements and frameworks for data access, classification, lineage, catalog structures, and tagging taxonomies

• Translating governance, compliance, and security requirements into clear technical specifications and platform controls

• Designing scalable access and operating models, including onboarding, approval workflows, roles, responsibilities, and ownership structures

• Advising on governance capabilities within Databricks, Unity Catalog, and cloud-based identity and access management solutions

• Aligning governance policies with platform implementation and producing governance documentation, access model designs, and process descriptions

• Advising and challenging stakeholders to embed governance into platform processes and enable efficient, governed data product delivery across teams and business domains

You will play a key role in embedding governance into our data platform landscape, working closely with experienced specialists across data, security, architecture, and governance to shape standards and practices that support the long-term strategic use of data throughout the organization. You will help ensure governance and compliance enable scalable data delivery rather than create bottlenecks as platform adoption grows.

About you | Platform architecture mindset and governance credibility

To succeed in this role, you combine strong governance thinking with a solid technical foundation. You understand how modern cloud-based enterprise data platforms are designed, established, and operated because you have helped build, evolve, or govern them in previous roles. You enjoy translating complexity into clarity and can confidently engage with both technical specialists and business stakeholders.

You will be most successful if you:

Must-have qualifications

• Have at least 4 years of experience within data platform architecture, data platform engineering, data governance, data management, or related disciplines, including experience contributing to the design, implementation, or evolution of an enterprise-scale data platform.

• Possess hands-on experience with Databricks and Unity Catalog, including RBAC, governance controls, catalog and schema structures, lineage, classification, tagging, and security capabilities.

• Understand cloud-based identity and access management, including Azure Entra ID, Active Directory, RBAC, ABAC, service principals, and storage permissions, and be able to translate governance requirements into clear, implementable technical specifications.

• Have experience designing and implementing governance models and processes for how data is onboarded, structured, accessed, governed, and delivered across a modern data platform.

• Have experience establishing operating models for data ownership, stewardship, and data product delivery, combined with strong stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

It is an advantage if you

• Have experience from a regulated industry, such as insurance, financial services, or healthcare, and have worked with GDPR, privacy requirements, access governance, or compliance controls within cloud-based data platforms.

• Have experience designing enterprise-wide data classification frameworks, tagging taxonomies, and scalable governance practices, where compliance requirements are embedded into platform capabilities and automated processes.

• Understand modern data architecture and platform automation, including medallion architecture, data products, domain-driven ownership models, infrastructure-as-code, GitLab, Terraform, and CI/CD practices.

• Hold relevant certifications, such as CDMP, DAMA, or Databricks certifications.

You are naturally collaborative, analytical, and pragmatic, with a talent for challenging assumptions and turning complexity into practical solutions. You understand how to balance risk, usability, and business value, embedding governance into the platform to enable trusted data delivery at scale.
